goal: Verify that the P3 Warm Workspace satisfies its requirements on the exact fixed Snapshot.

deliverables: Stable workspace root per (Campaign, node) under the XDG cache directory, recorded in the Warm Set
Rebase: apply the tree diff to a copy-on-write clone of the previous template; the resulting manifest digest must equal the new head's Tree Digest or the kernel falls back to full materialization
WorkspaceRebased@1 event with from and to Snapshot IDs, verified digest and entries touched
Per-Attempt sandboxes remain fresh clones; sibling isolation is unchanged
Schemas, parity fixtures, one ADR numbered after the latest, README index entry, CHANGELOG Unreleased entry
acceptance: A corrupted rebase fails closed into full materialization and records why
Rebase and full materialization produce byte-identical trees on the existing fixtures
A Round on an unchanged head materializes nothing
